spans.s:
n. (-कं)
A flock of owls.
E.
उलूक, and अण् aff.

m. (-क्यः)
A follower of the Vaiśeṣika doctrine.
E.
उलूक an owl, and ष्यञ् affix, like an owl: this etymology, and perhaps the word, owes its origin probably to controversial animosity.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Ground or pounded in a mortar.
E.
उलूखल, अण् aff.
